comment: One row for each rule of part 1 of the leak rule of D17.20 in the emptiness pass
(src/fort/owner/prover.ft): the obligation of each exit kind, the scope of a named local at a
`return`, the facts and the bits that prove an exit, and the work limit. Then one row for each
rule of the error of the leak rule (src/fort/owner/report.ft), for the error in a build
(src/fort/gen_fir.ft) and under --check and --fir (src/fort/driver.ft), and for the option
--leak-report. The rows D17.20-inner hold part 2, which only reports: the sites of a `del` and
of a `cast` (src/fort/owner/prover.ft), the inner owners of a type and their paths
(src/fort/owner/place.ft) and the count and the depth that the layout of a struct keeps
(src/fort/types.ft), the facts, the walk and the limit of the proof, the lines of the
report (src/fort/owner/report.ft) and the list of --leak-report (src/fort/driver.ft), and
D17.20-inner-error makes part 2 an error, which no build gives yet. The first stage runs the
cases over FIR text and over lowered fort source (test/fort/owner/prover_test.ft), with one
case for each exit kind: the closing brace, `return`, `break`, `continue` and an exit into an
abort block, and the cases of part 2, and the errors and the lines of part 2
(test/fort/owner/report_test.ft). The second runs the driver test, which holds the error in
each build mode, under --check and under --fir, and the lines of --leak-report. The third
runs the oracle test, which prints a false accept for each row that makes the pass prove an exit
or a site of part 2 that a run leaks at. The fourth runs the fail tests of
test/lang/fail/ownership, whose goldens hold the error at each exit kind. The table runs in the
Linux VM with the debug preset and the default runner. The md5 guard reads the product
compiler, whose driver and emitter import owner.prover and owner.report.
The first round of a run can read stale (notes/testing.md 7), so the first row is one that
a full run caught.
The rows D17.20-inner-empty, -empty-scratch, -site-fact, -site-steps and -site-stale hold the
obligation of part 2 that the fact of the released place proves (src/fort/owner/prover.ft): a
`del` or an owning `cast` of a place that holds the zero value frees nothing, and the inner work
counts that fact.

stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 1500 -j 2 owner/prover_test owner/report_test

stages.name: the driver test
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 1500 -j 2 driver_test

stages.name: the oracle test
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 1500 -j 2 owner/oracle_test
